newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Nordbanken stake expected to be sold to Investor - paper. [Corrected 09:22 gmt]
newsitem.headline: Nordbanken stake expected to be sold to Investor - paper. [Corrected 09:22 gmt]

text.p: (Corrects headline from "sold by state to Investor")

The Swedish government is expected to sell (corrects from "has sold") 20-25 percent of its shares in Nordbanken to the Wallenberg empire's investment vehicle, Investor AB, a Swedish newspaper said on Friday quoting informed sources.
Dagens Industri said the sale would paved the way for the Wallenberg related S-E-Banken to merge with Nordbanken. The move was widely speculated in the financial markets in recent weeks.
Wallenberg companies own 15 percent of capital and 16 percent of votes in S-E-Banken.

Nordbanken shares on Thursday bucked negative trends and rose nine crowns to 215.5 crowns on continued merger rumours and on a Thursday newspaper report that Morgan Stanley placed the share on its priority list, dealers said.
